ambiguity_flags.note: The proposed replacement for 'Layer-2' imports 'truth' semantics that overlap with the established canonical concept 'Snapshot Truth' (SNAPSHOT_TRUTH). A reader could interpret 'truth_store' as a store of Snapshot Truth values rather than the architectural ingestion and observation layer. This creates Category A (snapshot boundary) ambiguity: blurring the distinction between the architectural layer and the immutable snapshot truth artifact it publishes. The two concepts are governed separately and must remain terminologically distinct.

The proposed replacement for 'Layer-3' overlaps with decision-vocabulary governed terms. 'decision_layer' is semantically adjacent to the discouraged LAYER_3 variant 'decision engine' and implies a currently-operational decision capability. CLAUDE.md Section 3.2 states Layer-3 components are 'planned only'; Section 10 forbids claiming 'Layer 3 is implemented'. Using 'decision_layer' as a normalized current-state label — even in documentation-only contexts — risks inadvertently promoting the target-state Layer-3 architecture to current-state status. Category B (phase/readiness) and Category D (decision vocabulary) governance-sensitive drift confirmed.
